summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K on October 12, 2026, furnishing a fact sheet, a stockholder letter from Chairman/CEO Eric Brock, and a press release announcing the formation of Regna AI, a standalone company with Palantir. The disclosure is a Regulation FD and Other Events update, not a transaction. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or closing date were stated. The filing mechanics are informational only, with exhibits not deemed filed under Section 18. Watch for any future capital or ownership structure tied to Regna AI.
